Announces plan to acquire additional Northern Data shares from Tether to raise ownership from 85.2% to about 98%.

Tether reported agreeing to acquire 8,256,155 Northern Data shares expected to be exchanged on/about Sept 30, 2026.
RUM Group will submit formal squeeze-out request under German Stock Corporation Act to obtain remaining ~2% (price may differ).
